title: Miniature Self Portrait
prompt:
IMPORTANT: Use the uploaded image as the ONLY identity reference. Preserve the exact face, facial structure, skin tone, beard, hairstyle, glasses, age, body proportions, expression, and identity from the uploaded photo. Do not beautify, feminize, or replace the face. The subject must remain instantly recognizable.

Create an ultra-realistic surreal cinematic studio portrait of the same person sitting cross-legged on a seamless studio floor with a soft sky-blue gradient background.

Change only the outfit to an oversized mustard yellow hoodie, relaxed gray jeans, and mustard-and-white canvas sneakers while keeping the body shape and proportions consistent with the reference image.

The subject smiles gently while looking at a tiny miniature version of himself (8–12 cm tall) standing confidently on his open palm.

Around him, create 10–12 unique miniature versions of the same person, each with the exact same face, hairstyle, glasses, beard, clothing, and identity, naturally interacting in different positions:

Sitting on both shoes
Climbing the hoodie sleeve
Walking across the jeans
Waving from the shoulder
Reading a tiny book
Taking a selfie
Dancing
Chatting together
Leaning against the sneaker
Sitting on the knee
Looking up at the giant version
Pointing toward the miniature on the palm

Every miniature must have a different pose and natural body language—no duplicated poses or cloned appearance.

Use true-to-scale proportions, realistic contact shadows beneath every miniature, physically accurate perspective, and believable interactions with clothing folds.
